$comment: Shared Button bindings, used by every theme. Each points a contract row at a role token (theme-button-*) or a Spectrum semantic token, never a palette step. Each theme sets the values of the theme-button-* tokens it uses. Defaults: each role token starts at Spectrum's own value, so a theme lists only what it changes.

bindings.reason: Spectrum binds Button straight to the gray palette. gray-800 is used far beyond Button, so it cannot be changed. Pointing this row at the semantic token lets the theme reach it.
